description: Create or reuse a canonical character sheet folder with sheet.md and sheet.meta.yaml so the character can be indexed immediately. If the folder already exists, missing canonical files are backfilled and the existing sheet is preserved.

fields.description: Optional starter metadata fields for the character sidecar.

name.description: Display name of the character (e.g. 'Mira Nystrom').

notes.description: Optional starter prose content for sheet.md.

project_id.description: Project scope for a book-local character (e.g. 'universe-1/book-1-the-lamb' or 'test-novel').

universe_id.description: Universe scope for a cross-book shared character (e.g. 'universe-1').

name: create_character_sheet
